comments.comment: This is some very dichotomous logic, here. She regrets that it happened, but not the choice....to invoke it happening at all? And then she thinks about it almost every day, but says she has no regret over her choice? I'm not in this woman's head, but this isn't a rational way of processing regret. I suspect she may need some post-abortive counseling to this end.
Denial is strong in this one. I pray she finds healing
She regrets that it happened, meaning getting pregnant when she wasn’t ready. But doesn’t regret getting the abortion.
If becomes true if they repeat it to themselves enough times 🙄
These poor women are in such deep denial about what they’ve done.
So she doesn’t regret it. This kind of statement is exactly why we shouldn’t just give blanket immunity under the law to women who abort.
